data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing an easy way to create a circle button navigation bar.
data.what_it_does: It renders a bottom navigation bar with a distinct circular button animation for the active tab. It supports active/inactive icons, custom gradients, shadows, corner radii, and optional level text labels.
use_when: You want a bottom navigation bar featuring a raised circular button design.
You need custom animations and gradient styling for navigation items.
avoid_when: You require a standard Material BottomNavigationBar adhering strictly to Material Design guidelines.
You need side navigation or drawer-based navigation instead of a bottom bar.
strengths: Easy to customize with shadows, gradients, and corner radii.
Provides active and inactive icon/level text definitions.
weaknesses: Limited to a bottom navigation bar widget layout.
Relies entirely on custom paint and layout configurations for its specific aesthetic.
data.setup_notes: No native permissions or additional setup steps required.
data.minimal_example:
Scaffold(
      bottomNavigationBar: CircleNavBar(
        activeIcons: const [
          Icon(Icons.person, color: Colors.deepPurple),
          Icon(Icons.home, color: Colors.deepPurple),
          Icon(Icons.favorite, color: Colors.deepPurple),
        ],
        inactiveIcons: const [
          Text("My"),
          Text("Home"),
          Text("Like"),
        ],
        color: Colors.white,
        circleColor: Colors.white,
        height: 60,
        circleWidth: 60,
        initIndex: 1,
        onChanged: (v) {},
      ),
)
